I'm looking at the Base64 constructor with lineLength and lineSeparator options. If I set the line length to 4 and use a separator of a new byte array containing a newline character, then for the input "abcdef," it's likely I'll get an output of "YWJj\nZGVm." It seems like a neat way to format encoded data, but I wonder if there’s anything else I should keep in mind regarding performance or readability.
